sources.title: Copilot usage and billing metrics
sources.used_for: account.getQuota, models.list, context event fields; credits, requests and dollars remain distinct.

sources.title: Copilot generated RPC
sources.used_for: Public generated wire request/result shapes including connect and experimental permissions/options APIs. Moving main branch is NOT a pinned certification version.

sources.title: Copilot SDK client
sources.used_for: Owned headless stdio launcher and Content-Length transport; reviewed source informs adapter, not a tested SDK dependency.

sources.title: Copilot SDK session
sources.used_for: Session events, lifecycle and permission flow; metadata-only projection.

sources.title: ACP v1 schema
sources.used_for: Capability negotiation; load/list/mode/auth remain conditional rather than assumed parity.

sources.title: Gemini ACP
sources.used_for: Explicit --acp transport; actual installed capabilities still checked.

sources.title: Gemini hooks
sources.used_for: SessionStart/SessionEnd and turn/tool/compaction metadata; optional user setup only.

sources.title: Gemini headless
sources.used_for: Session/model cumulative token data; not a live subscription quota or current context measurement.

sources.title: OpenCode ACP
sources.used_for: opencode acp and supported session operations; no current-account exercise.

sources.title: Cline ACP
sources.used_for: --acp, opt-in auto-approval flag, native persisted sessions and client permission handling.

sources.title: Claude statusline
sources.used_for: five_hour/seven_day used_percentage and resets_at; fields may be absent. Configured reported input is not a separately authenticated API query.

sources.title: Claude hooks
sources.used_for: Normalize lifecycle metadata; Stop/turn-end is not SessionEnd.

sources.title: Worktrunk list
sources.used_for: Schema2 local output and selectable data collection; no cleanup authority inferred.

sources.title: Worktrunk switch
sources.used_for: Exact worktree creation with explicit config/no-hooks/no-cd; do not delegate broad background branch deletion.

sources.title: Worktrunk configuration
sources.used_for: Project hooks and custom commands are untrusted executable configuration; scoped empty config.

sources.title: Codex App Server
sources.used_for: Inherited supported thread/account interfaces; no private Desktop format assumption.

sources.title: Git worktree
sources.used_for: Authoritative NUL listing and non-force removal; retain branch/ref and coordinate external writers.

sources.title: Git status
sources.used_for: Tracked/untracked/ignored distinction; complete clean status alone is not disposal authority.

sources.title: Windows process identity
sources.used_for: Reusable PIDs require creation-qualified identity. Source inspection, not a Windows test.

sources.title: Windows DPAPI
sources.used_for: User-scope encryption at rest is not same-user malware isolation or portable password-vault backup.

sources.title: Windows Job Objects
sources.used_for: Owned subprocess lifecycle only; no attaching a killer job to arbitrary agent sessions.

limitations: Moving documentation/source is not a compatibility guarantee.
Exact product binaries, dependency graph, vendor authentication and native behavior were not exercised.
Inherited direct dependency pins still require a genuine Cargo resolver and advisory/license review.
